answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. An attacker must acquire a massive token stake to manipulate the network, creating a high economic horizon that renders identity fabrication prohibitively expensive. This security layer acts like a protective opal, shielding the system from illicit agents, while any malicious ripple in consensus triggers immediate slashing of the perpetrator's collateral assets, ensuring network integrity.
